changelog: Material icons retain theme selectors, selected/disabled colors and alpha; corrected light/dark and player-button foregrounds.
Theme updates refresh existing owned icons, preserve explicit colors and avoid tinting profile artwork or provider logos.
Device Tweaks: repaired library grids, native sorting, keyboard cleanup and rebound tablet/TV poster/focus behavior.
Settings sharing honors category selection, imports only supplied values and uses bounded, acknowledged transfers.
Receiver restart/shutdown and discovery cancellation are owned; stale scans no longer update dismissed pickers.
Watch Positions transfers real selected-account playback positions through CloudStream storage and Android document picking; existing positions are preserved.
ATTENTION: Tablet/TV tweaks require the matching device layout. Position transfer is not a library or Continue Watching backup.
ATTENTION: LAN transfers remain unencrypted and require local approval. Syncplay TLS behavior is unchanged.
ATTENTION: Update through dcext or the CS3M Updater, then fully restart CloudStream. Physical-device and two-device LAN confirmation remain pending.
message: v738 - Icon colors, Device Tweaks and Sync & Sharing repairs
